newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay July trade deficit $108.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay July trade deficit $108.7 mln.

text.p: Uruguay ran up a trade deficit of $108.7 million in July, up from a $30.1 million deficit in the same month last year, the Central Bank said on Thursday.
Imports rose to $309.8 million in July, compared with $218.6 million in July 1995. Exports rose to $201.1 million, from $188.5 million in July 1995.
Uruguay ran up an accumulated trade deficit of $425.1 million in the first seven months of the year, compared with a $350.1 million deficit in the same period last year.
Imports over the period were $1.74 billion, up from $1.63 billion. Exports were $1.32 billion, up from $1.28 billion in the first seven months of 1995.
